title: Screen ad content model
description: The only source of truth for on-screen items, prices, allergens and legal lines. The generator NEVER invents, derives or rounds any of these values.

language.description: Drives number/date formatting and the default copy strings.

badge.description: Optional corner badge text, e.g. 'Heute · Mittwoch'.

hours.description: Opening-hours line as displayed. Must be confirmed by the operator; the generator does not derive it.

items.description: 1-5 items. The landscape menu-board template fits 4 items at full type size; a 5th is allowed but the template warns.

id.description: Stable slug; names the output folder under work/images/<id>/.

name.description: Dish name exactly as it must appear on screen.

description.description: Ingredient line. No health claims: 'superfood', 'detox', 'heilt', 'entgiftet' are rejected by the validator.

price.description: Final consumer price in EUR including VAT and service charges (PAngV). Never a placeholder, never a range.

currency.description: Only EUR is implemented in v1.

promo.description: Short ribbon text, e.g. 'Neu'. Do not use 'war/now' price claims unless the old price genuinely ran.

allergens.description: EU-14 codes (LMIV Annex II). A=Gluten B=Krebstiere C=Ei D=Fisch E=Erdnuss F=Soja G=Milch H=Schalenfrüchte I=Sellerie J=Senf K=Sesam L=Schwefeldioxid M=Lupine N=Weichtiere. Empty array = the operator declared no allergens; it must be explicit, never omitted.

diet.description: Only declare what the operator confirmed. The generator never infers a diet label from the ingredient text.

focalPoint.description: [x, y] in 0..1 source-image coordinates. Overrides the alpha-centroid fallback.

promo.description: Optional full-screen promo loop appended after the menu board in the same video.

terms.description: Contract terms (minimum term, notice period, validity). Only set this when the operator confirmed it; leaving it out is safe, inventing it is not.

image.description: Photo filename for the promo background, relative to --photos.

vatNote.description: e.g. 'Preise inkl. MwSt.' Required: PAngV requires the total price to be evident.

allergenNote.description: e.g. 'vollständige Liste auf der gedruckten Karte'.
